description: This file is a header (.h) for the Components_AudioOutput module, defining the class hostIf_STBServiceAudioInterface which provides APIs and data structures for managing audio output capabilities in a TR-069 based STB device. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and documentation related to audio output features and configurations.
